# Jaipur Bus Live

> Real-time JCTSL bus GPS tracking, route schedules, bus stops, and Jaipur Metro guide for commuters in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India.

Jaipur Bus Live (JBL) provides commuter transit intelligence for the city of Jaipur. It tracks active Jaipur City Transport Services Limited (JCTSL) city buses with real-time GPS telemetry, offers direct route planning and bus stop lookup, and includes the official Jaipur Metro Pink Line guide and emergency SOS services.

## Core Capabilities

- **Real-Time Bus Tracking**: Live GPS coordinates, vehicle bearing, speed, and status (Moving, Slow, Stopped, Idle) for active JCTSL city buses.
- **Route Catalog**: 54+ active bus routes covering Mansarovar, Amer, Sanganer, Badi Chaupar, Chhoti Chaupar, Vaishali Nagar, and Jagatpura.
- **Bus Stops Directory**: 360+ verified and geo-referenced bus stops across the Jaipur metropolitan area with user distance calculation.
- **Jaipur Metro Guide**: Pink Line corridor stations, fare stages, timetable, and interchange details.
- **Emergency SOS**: One-touch emergency helplines including Police (112), Women Helpline (1090), and Ambulance (108).

## Primary Resources

- [Jaipur Bus Live Web App](https://jaipur-bus-live.web.app/): Main web application for real-time JCTSL bus tracking, routes, and stops
- [Live Bus Telemetry API](https://jaipur-bus-live-5nvg.vercel.app/api/live-buses): Real-time GPS locations, bearing, and speeds of active JCTSL buses
- [Bus Routes API](https://jaipur-bus-live-5nvg.vercel.app/api/routes): Complete directory of 54 active transit routes with ordered stop sequences
- [Bus Stops API](https://jaipur-bus-live-5nvg.vercel.app/api/bus-stops): Geo-referenced catalog of 360+ verified bus stops across Jaipur

## Optional

- [AI Transit Catalog](https://jaipur-bus-live.web.app/ai-catalog.json): Structured JSON service manifest and machine-readable transit catalog
- [Jaipur Metro Pink Line](https://jaipur-bus-live.web.app/#metro): Station details, interchange info, and fare structure
- [Emergency Helplines Directory](https://jaipur-bus-live.web.app/#emergency): 24x7 emergency contacts for Jaipur public safety and medical aid
